headline: Major shift in civil service: PSC Chairman resigns
summary: The Chairman of the Public Service Commission (PSC) has stepped down from his position.
details: The Chairman of the Public Service Commission (PSC) has officially resigned from his post.
The PSC is the primary body responsible for the recruitment of civil servants in Bangladesh.
This resignation comes as a part of broader changes within the administrative and regulatory bodies of the country.
Further details regarding the appointment of a successor have not yet been announced.

headline_marked: Khulna: [[Youth killed in mob beating]] over child-lifter suspicion
headline: Khulna: Youth killed in mob beating over child-lifter suspicion
summary: A young man was beaten to death by a crowd in Khulna after being suspected of kidnapping children.
details: A young man was killed after being subjected to a mob beating in Khulna. The attack occurred after the victim was suspected of being a child-lifter.
The incident sparked panic and tension in the local area as a crowd gathered and attacked the youth based on suspicion.
The victim was later taken to the hospital, but he succumbed to his injuries.
Local authorities are investigating the incident to identify the attackers and verify the claims regarding the victim's activities.
